_comment: Skill admission and refusal ledger (road-to-skill-estate-drawdown Phase 3). The five skill-growth questions from skill-writing/references/procedure.md 0b live HERE, not in a PR body: check_finding_dispositions.ts:11 rejects that surface for findings in its own words -- a comment is mutable and unaudited, it is transport, not a record. Read by src/scripts/check_skill_admissions.ts, FORWARD-ONLY: only skills added since the base ref need a row, so the 299 already in the tree are grandfathered by construction rather than by a list someone maintains. Fields on an `admitted` row: skill, decision, date, family, capability, why_not_extend, why_not_a_guideline, visibility. A `rejected` row needs skill, decision, date and `instead`, and must NOT name a skill that exists.

_absence_of_refusals: AC-5 asks for one historical refusal backfilled OR the absence of any recorded. The absence is recorded, because it is the finding: a grep for a refused skill proposal over archive/, later/ and stubs/ returns the recurring OBSERVATION that the count keeps climbing (road-to-capability-governance.md:46) and one 2026-05-01 audit that captured the count as data (road-to-governance-cleanup.md:64). No skill proposal was ever refused in a form the tree records -- which is exactly what a ledger kept in PR bodies would produce, and is the defect rather than a gap in this backfill. The first genuine `rejected` row will be the first visible no.

instead: Ships as a command routed through production-validator, which carries unscoped Bash and can invoke it deterministically. AI council 2/2: the evidence establishes a COVERAGE gap, not a SKILL-SHAPED gap -- a site-type-conditional config, 7 deterministic checks, 4 tiers, 18 schema tests and a hard pass/fail benchmark gate are the signature of a linter. `later/` was refused explicitly: parking implies the problem is timing or evidence, and it is neither. Reopen only on demonstrated failures in discovery, orchestration or interpretation that cannot be fixed in the validator or the command contract -- and cite THAT evidence, not the original 0-of-8 coverage gap. Recorded at road-to-web-launch-readiness b-estate-decision-web-launch.
